structure.unit: Professions and Occupations Regulated by Boards Within the Department of Health Professions

law.catch_line: Restrictions on practitioners of the healing arts
law.text: A practitioner of the healing arts shall not sell or dispense controlled substances except as provided in §§ 54.1-2914 and 54.1-3304.1. Such exceptions shall extend only to his own patients unless he is licensed to practice pharmacy.
